bilo: biti — to be; bilo koji — any
broj: noun masc.; broj poena — number of points
crvenoj: crven — red; loc. case fem. sg.
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dan: noun masc.; dobar dan — good afternoon
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
doselili: doseliti se — to move (here); past masc. pl.
dovela: dovesti — to bring, to lead; past fem. sg.
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
ganjali: ganjati se — to chase each other; past masc. pl.
godine: godina — year; gen. case: naredne godine — next year
gradu: grad; loc. case: po gradu — around the city
hvala: hvala vam puno — thank you very much
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ide: ići — to go, to ride; gde se ide — where you need to go
ili: conjunction; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kiflice: kiflica — bread roll; acc. case pl.
kod: preposition + gen. case: kod znaka — by the sign; kod Marija — at Mario's
kući: kuća — house; idemo kući — we're driving home
l': li — interrogative particle; je l' — «really, or what» (colloquial)
ljuljala: ljuljati se — to swing; past neut. pl.
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
mogu: moći — to be able; 1st pers. sg. (also 3rd pers. pl. — «they can»)
može: moći — to be able; 3rd pers. sg.; «može» — «all right, it's okay»
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
najbližem: blizak — near; superlative loc. case masc. sg.
najbolje: superlative of dobar; nije baš najbolje — not the best
napisala: napisati — to write; past fem. sg.
nasmejala: nasmejati se — to laugh; past fem. sg.
nasmejale: nasmejati se — to laugh; past fem. pl.
neka: neki — some, a certain; fem. sg. or neut. pl.
novom: Novi Zeland — New Zealand; loc. case
obavezan: obavezan — compulsory; nom. case masc. sg.
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
ogrebao: ogrebati — to scrape; past masc. sg.
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
pao: pasti — to fall; pao je mrak — got dark
pazi: paziti — to pay attention, to be attentive; imperative, sg.
penje: penjati se — to climb; 3rd pers. sg.
pitate: pitati se — to wonder; ako se pitate — if you're curious
plastičnom: plastičan — plastic; instr. case fem. sg.
pogledale: pogledati se — to look at each other; past fem. pl.
popeo: popeti se — to climb; past masc.
posmatra: posmatrati — to observe; 3rd pers. sg. («koji se posmatra»)
potrčala: potrčati — to run; past fem. sg.
pripremni: pripremni — preparatory; nom. case masc. sg.
pripremnu: pripremni — preparatory; acc. case fem. sg.
promrmljao: promrmljati — to mutter; past masc. sg.
puno: hvala puno — thank you very much
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
sela: selo — village; gen. sg. (do sela) or pl. (sela su)
slavi: slaviti — to mark, to celebrate; 3rd pers. sg.
smo: biti, 1st pers. pl.: stigli smo — we arrived
spuštala: spuštati se — to slide down; past neut. pl.
stavite: you will put, you will put on
ste: biti, 2nd pers. pl.: što ste tu — what are you doing here
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
treba: trebati — to be needed; treba ti — you need
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ustala: ustati — to stand up; past fem. sg.
već: adverb «already»; after negation — «a» (nije selo već gradić)
viknuo: viknuti — to shout; past masc. sg.
vrtiću: vrtić — small garden; loc. case sg.
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zagrlila: zagrliti — to hug; past fem. sg.
znači: značiti — to mean; as an introductory word — «so, in short»
četiri: numeral; četiri i po — four and a half
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
